GridContainer

The GridContainer control divides its area into rows and columns. Each row can have a different number of columns, allowing you to build layouts without assigning a position to every control.

Properties and Methods

  • GridContainer(rows, animateExpansion, columnsPerRow): Creates the grid. Each row needs a positive column count. The parameterless constructor creates one row with one column.
  • AddElement / SetCell: Adds an element at a zero-based row and column, or changes the cell of a child already in the grid. Children.Add initially places an element at (0,0).
  • Rows / ColumnsPerRow: The row and column counts selected in the constructor. These cannot be changed afterwards.
  • AnimateOpen / AnimateClose: Opens or closes the grid with a short animation. AnimateClose can call a final action after closing.

Cells fill the available space, including any extra cells left over from integer division.

The common position, color, visibility and lifetime settings are inherited from UIElement. While attached to a running window, update the control on the UI thread.
